tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /man ngag brgya bcu dgu'i them byang bzhugs so//

lung med/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yig man ngag snying po'i don brgya dang bcu dgu dag tu grangs bcad pas: gsang ba'i man ngag 1dum dum khrigs dang*/ po ti 2smug chung*/ 'khrul gzhi 3gsal ba'i me long dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i 4gnad yig dang*/ rin chen 5gser thig dang*/ snang byed 6sgron ma dang*/ 'od 7gsal lde mig dang*/ shes bya skor 8gsum dang*/ gsang 9ba'i sdom byang dang*/ sgra rtags 10'khor lo dang bcu/ sku gsum 11lag khrid dang*/ mkha' 'gro 12pra khrid dang*/ babs lugs 13gsum skor dang*/ 'khrul pa'i sdebs 14yig dang*/ gsang 15tig chen po dang*/ gser 16byang bkol ba dang*/ lam khrid 17chen po dang*/ ye shes 18lag phrad dang*/ bka' sgrom 19chen po dang*/ bsam gtan rang 20gtad dang nyi shu'o/ /gsal 21ba'i me long dang*/ gsang ba'i 22snying khol dang*/ snang ba 23bsdus pa dang*/ gnas pa'i 24byung khungs dang*/ khrigs chod 25bdun pa dang*/ thod rgal 26dgu pa dang*/ lung bstan 27chen mo dang*/ glang chen 28drug pa dang*/ spyod lam 29bsdus pa dang*/ lta ba'i gser 30bkod dang sum cu/ 31pad+ma klong yangs dang*/ lha'i 32phyag gsor ma dang*/ gser gyi 33ut+pal dang*/ dran pa'i 34rgyun gcod dang*/ rig 35pa lam slong dang*/ 'phra rgyud 36dril ba dang*/ gsal ba'i 37sgron me dang*/ seng ge rtsal 38sprugs dang*/ a ti 39gnas dgongs dang*/ dgongs don 40bzhi pa dang bzhi bcu/ rdo rje lam 41bstan dang*/ rin chen 'od 42'bar dang*/ lhag pa'i 'khor 43lo dang*/ khyung chen 44mkha' lding dang*/ lta ba'i 45dmigs sel dang*/ bla ma'i 46rim pa dang*/ drang ba'i tshig 47rgyud dang*/ 'khrul gzhi 48rtsad gcod dang*/ sems kyi 49dmigs drug dang*/ bsgom pa'i 50'khor lo dang lnga bcu/ dbang gi 51lde mig dang*/ dbang gi 52las byang dang*/ spros med 53dbang gi man ngag dang*/ dbang gi 54rtsa ba dang*/ dbang gi 55rig byed dang*/ dbang gi 56phra tig dang*/ 'khor lo 57drug pa'i dbang dang*/

dam tshig 58rab 'byed dang*/ dbang bkod 59chen mo dang*/ dbang sbyor 60phra khrid dang drug cu/ rig pa'i 61me tog dang*/ gser lung 62chen mo dang*/ man ngag 63rtsa ba dang*/ lung tig 64bco brgyad dang*/ rim pa 65drug pa dang*/ sems lung 66bsgom khrigs dang*/ yang 67gsang dril ba dang*/ sbas pa'i 68nyi ma dang*/ 'phra 69bkod bcu pa dang*/ lung yig 70bsdus pa dngabadun cu/ bdud rtsi yang 71zhun dang*/ lung gsum 72'dus pa dang*/ g.yu yig 73can dang*/ 'phra yi 74gcan dang*/ gser yig 75can dang*/ snying 76gzer chen po dang*/ chung 77ngu dang*/ bsam 78gtan nyal ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ 79'phrul yig can dang*/ chung ba 80dang brgyad cu'o/ /mkha' 81'gro'i mdzod dang*/ 'phro ba 82chen mo dang*/ gsang ba'i 83gzer bu dang*/ rtsa gnas 84'khor lo dang*/ bsam gtan 85babs lugs dang*/ rig pa'i sa 86'byed dang/ snang ba 87rgyas 'debs dang*/ ye shes 88sbubs 'jug dang*/ lo rgyus 89chen mo dang dgu bcu/ gsang ba'i 91zhal chems dang*/ thig pa'i 92ru shan dang*/ gsang 93 ba'i sgra yig dang*/ yi ge'i sbyor 94 bshad dang*/ sgra bzhi'i 95 mtshams sbyor dang*/ brtan pa'i 96 go cha dang*/ 'gyur 97 med thig le dang*/ dngos po'i 98 kha bsgyur dang*/ 'bras bu'i 99dngos 'byed dang*/ stong pa'i 100mtha' 'byed dang brgya tham pa/ nam 101 mkha' lam khyer dang*/ thi bya 102tshang 'jug dang*/ gsal ba'i 103 rin chen 'od dang*/ ka dag chen po'i 104 dag yig dang*/ lhun grub 105 yi ge dang*/ shes 106 rab 'khor lo dang*/ smra ba'i 107 mtshon chen dang*/ ye shes 108 lnga bskor dang*/ 'od kyi 109 tshul bshad dang*/ 'byung ba'i 110 gnas 'byed dang bcu/ sgron ma'i 111 khungs gcod dang*/ phyag rgya 112 bsdus pa dang*/ bkod pa 113 lnga pa dang*/ rgya mtsho 114 ar gtad dang*/ rlung gi 115 sdom byang dang*/ ngo sprod 116 gsum pa dang*/ babs lugs 117 bcu gcig dang*/ rtsa tig 118 chen po dang*/ rlung gi them

119 yig dang*/ rig pa'i 120 gnas sa nyid dang*/ mig gi bsam 121 gtan dang bcu dgu'o/ /rtsa ba rtsa ba'i rgyud gnyis la sogs pa rdzogs pa rang byung dang yi ge med pa brgyad kyi tshul las ni/ /go rim 'jug cing nges par bstan na rnam bshad pa/ rtsa rgyud ni bskyed dang bshad bshad rgyud ni rang shar dang rang grol dang yan lag rin chen spung pa sku gdung 'bar ba dang // lung thal 'gyur bkra shis mdzes ldan rig pa gsal ba'i rgyud de rgyud sde bzhi dang man ngag me long gnyis ngo sprod spras pa mu tig 'phreng ba dgongs pa klong drug sgron ma 'bar ba nyi zla kha sbyor dang*/ / 'jug rang grol gnyis seng ge rtsal rdzogs nor bu phra bkod dang nag mo khros mkhas pa mchog ga ིsa bstan pa 'dzin pa gang zag gcig gi rkyen du bstan pa dang / / skyong ba dang rdzogs pa rang byung la sogs pa bsrung ba dang bco brgyad du byung*/ a+thi+-i/ rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum la/ rnal 'byor chen po ni rang yi dam lha'i sku gsung thugs rnal ma la/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'byor pas na rnal 'byor ro/ /shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ chos kyi dbyings ma bcos pa'i rnal ma la/ rang rig pa ye shes su 'byor bas na rnal 'byor ro/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ni/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid rnal ma la/ rig pa ye shes su 'byor pas na rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /de yang bka' las kyang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid dang gsum 'byor pas na/ rnal 'byor chen po zhes ni de la bya'o/ /chos dbyings ma bcos rnal ma la/ /rang rig ye shes blos 'byor pas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor zhes ni de la bya'o/ /chos nyid ma bcos rnam ma la/ /rang rig ye shes blos 'byor pas/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor zhes ni de la bya'o/ /sku 'jam gsung 'jam thugs 'jam 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal/ / rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum yang don la gcig go
// a+thi+-i// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (3)man ngag brgya bcu dgu'i them byang*/ -PAGE 270--PAGE 271--PAGE 268-
